summary: The candidate fixes and tests the reported UnifiedRadixCache retraction gaps, including real GPU host-capacity rejection, target+draft backup/restore metrics and rid logs, and injected synchronous submission failures. It does not complete the original full-lifecycle contract for the still-supported HiRadixCache path: ordinary L1 lookup remains unclassified, successful asynchronous L2-to-L1 completion has no request-correlated terminal log, and asynchronous L1-to-L2/L2-to-L1 completion exceptions re-raise without failure counters. The candidate is therefore a meaningful partial fix but not a full original-issue resolution.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction using the candidate regression held outside the checkout: all 3 tests failed because the base emitted no required retraction lifecycle logs; capacity, successful round-trip, and transfer-exception observability were absent.

3 passed on one AMD Instinct MI355X. Exercised real device/host pools, host-capacity failure, exact target+draft K/V GPU round trip, rid logs, success/failure transfer metrics, and injected submit failure.
17 passed; metric collector labels, monotonic deltas, and bounded transfer-result labels.
16 passed, 60 skipped, 2496 deselected; focused UnifiedRadixCache ordinary/buffer load-back behavior, with architecture/configuration-specific variants skipped by the suite.

Independent HiRadixCache adversarial injection: both loading_check and writing_check re-raised asynchronous completion errors with metric_calls=[] instead of recording bounded transfer_error failures.
Independent successful HiRadixCache L2-to-L1 completion: aggregate success metric was emitted, but no [HICACHE] terminal lifecycle log was emitted and ongoing_load_back retained no rid.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) was visible and used by the retraction regression under torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015. The test compares restored target and draft K/V tensors exactly.

native_rebuild_reason: The candidate changes Python, documentation, tests, and report artifacts only; no native C++/HIP/FlyDSL source or build definition changed. Imports resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/unified_radix_cache.py and /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/observability/metrics_collector.py. The prepared AITER module loaded from /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-c1b46e252224/cache/aiter/module_aiter_core.so.
remaining_counterexamples: HiRadixCache.loading_check re-raises a finish_event.synchronize() exception without incrementing hicache_transfer_requests_total{direction=l2_to_l1,result=failure,reason=transfer_error}.
HiRadixCache.writing_check re-raises a finish_event.synchronize() exception without incrementing hicache_transfer_requests_total{direction=l1_to_l2,result=failure,reason=transfer_error}.

A successful HiRadixCache L2-to-L1 completion emits the aggregate success metric but no request-correlated terminal [HICACHE] record; ongoing_load_back stores only the node, so the initiating rid is unavailable at completion.
HiRadixCache.init_load_back emits tier=l1 result=complete rather than a hit/miss classification with hit_tokens, and its only L2-to-L1 request log is result=scheduled rather than a terminal result.
remaining_limitations: Mooncake, HF3FS, NIXL, UMBP, multi-node, TP/PP distributed behavior, model-specific storage backends, and NVIDIA/CUDA were not available and remain unverified.
The GPU regression qualifies cache transport and exact synthetic K/V restoration, not HTTP serving behavior or model semantic accuracy.
The focused UnifiedRadixCache suite skipped 60 architecture/configuration-dependent cases.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate contains no native source changes.
